enum Key { Up, Down(i32), Stop }
machine HTTPServer2 on Key -> i32 {
    start A;
    state A {
        Key::Up -> goto B(1) with 1,
        Key::Down(by) -> { let twice: i32 = by * 2; goto B(twice) with twice; },
        Key::Stop -> stay with 0,
    }
    state B(level: i32) {
        Key::Up -> goto B(level + 1) with level,
        Key::Down(_) -> goto A with level,
        Key::Stop -> goto C with 0
    }
    final state C { Key::Up -> stay with 0, Key::Down(_) -> stay with 0, Key::Stop -> stay with 0 }
}

fn between() -> i32 { return 2; }

machine Skip on u8 {
    start Text;
    state Text {
        47 -> goto Slash,
        c -> stay,
    }
    state Slash {
        47 -> goto Text,
        _other -> { goto Text; }
    }
}
fn main() -> i32 { return between(); }
